about: The working folder's rules, as cases that every reader of them must agree on: scripts/working-folder.sh, which install.sh and install-cli.sh source; the sandboxed launcher, sdk/sandbox/launcher.sh; and the runtime's reader. sdk/test/install.test.ts, sdk/test/release.test.ts and tests/core/install.test.mjs run them against the installers, and tests/security against the launcher, so the copies of the rules can't drift apart.

A case builds under a scratch root, written ~ here. 'make' lists its entries: 'x/' a folder, 'x' an empty file, 'x -> y' a link to y. 'unlistable' lists folders the suite makes after those, then makes unreadable (mode 000); a suite running as root, which reads any folder, skips such a case. 'env' sets HOME, ZENIUS_HOME and TMPDIR over the defaults below, where TMPDIR is the suite's own unless a case sets it, and {PATH} is the PATH the suite had. Then the reader is asked to take 'folder'.

'outcome' is allowed, or the category of the reader's refusal, below. Each suite maps a category to its own wording, with 'kept' or 'repo' for the folder the reason names, by its real path. A case with 'by' holds only for those readers: install-cli.sh, install.sh, launcher or runtime.

Tokens a suite fills in: {cli} the CLI copy, {bin} the folder of the zenius command, {node} the node the suite runs, {profile} Zen's profile, {profiles} a folder that holds the profile but not ~, and {app} Zen's app folder, where the suite can name it (ZEN_BIN on Linux). The installer suites install once before the refused cases, which then share one root: no case's entries change another's outcome, and a refusal changes nothing. Each allowed case gets a root of its own.

'configs' are config.json texts edited by hand, with {folder} for an absolute folder. No reader takes an 'unreadable' one, and none falls back to ~/zenius-files then. Every reader takes the folder a 'readable' one names.

outcomes.shared: the home folder, a temporary folder, or a folder above one
outcomes.kept: 'kept', a folder inside it, or a folder that holds it: zenius's, Zen's, settings or credentials
outcomes.project: a folder holding .git or .envrc, as a file, a link (dangling or not), or a folder with anything in it or that can't be listed. An empty .git folder, which git takes for no repository, isn't one
outcomes.worktree: a folder inside the git work tree at 'repo', below the home folder or a temporary folder and above the root. An empty .git folder on the way isn't one, and the walk goes on past it, as git's does
outcomes.not-yours: a folder that isn't the user's own
outcomes.not-a-folder: something that isn't a folder: a file, a link to one, or a dangling link
outcomes.no-parent: a folder that isn't there, in a folder that isn't there either
outcomes.not-plain: a path with a double quote, a backslash or a control character, which config.json can't hold unescaped
